correctness.rationale: For smooth x(T^4+aT^3+bT^2+aT+1)|_{T=x^2} of degree 9, the genus is four. Direct coefficient extraction from f(x)^3 verifies M_{ij}=c_{7i-j} in the differential basis. Its permuted 2x2 anti-diagonal blocks have common determinant D=uw-v and each a unit entry, so Cartier rank is 4 if D!=0 and exactly 2 if D=0; the a-number is 0 or 2. Crucially the semilinear Cartier iterate is tested with Frobenius twist: on D=0 the twisted products are rank two for E=1+u^7*w!=0 and nilpotent for E=0, giving stable 7-ranks 2 and 0. An independent GF(7) SymPy symbolic reconstruction in this audit checked all 16 Cartier matrix entries, determinant D^2, and lex Groebner elimination of (D,E) giving degree-22 P(a) with squarefree part degree 20. The discriminant after the unique b substitution is coprime to P, so all twenty geometric solutions are smooth; the 20 count is not merely GF(7) or GF(49) sample evidence. The examined verification scripts independently compute the F49 sample and characteristic-7 algebra. Limitation: coefficient-marked parameter points, not isomorphism classes or Newton polygons.
